__meta__.name: OER/IA Adoption
__meta__.description: OER / Inclusive-Access adoption. Cards 31/32 use canonical #58 Course Materials Use rows: card 31's OER/IA rate denominator is classified Use materials (FormatType present), while card 32's coverage denominator is all Use material rows. Card 26 divides section adoption by the complete valid master_section spine; card 05 counts inferred-required Use rows. FormatType coverage falls 75.27% (2024-1) to 57.86% (2025-4), so absolute IA counts must be read with coverage; the classified-material rate is comparatively flat.
